Always current View All Free News & Updates Read the latest news from ZLSB — new acquisitions, programme highlights, community events, and library updates. Latest Updates Read News How to Get Started Access ZLSB's online services in four easy steps — no technical knowledge required. 1 Register Online Visit register.php and fill in the simple form. Membership is completely free for all citizens of Zanzibar. 2 Get Your Card After online approval, visit any ZLSB branch to collect your membership card. Children under 12 register with a parent or guardian. 3 Search & Browse Use the OPAC to search for books, explore e-resources, and download documents — from any device, at any time of day. 4 Borrow & Renew Reserve books online, then collect from your nearest branch. Use your member account to renew loans and manage your reading list. E-Resources Online Databases & E-Resources ZLSB provides access to trusted open-access databases and partner e-resource platforms to support academic research and lifelong learning. External DOAJ — Directory of Open Access Journals Thousands of free, peer-reviewed academic journals covering science, education, health, social sciences, and more. Free Access Visit External AfricaBib — African Studies Bibliography Comprehensive bibliographic database covering African studies, East African history, and Swahili literature. Free Access Visit External JSTOR — Academic Journals Archive Access thousands of academic journals, books, and primary sources. Free reading access for up to 100 articles per month. Free (Limited) Visit External Open Library — Internet Archive Borrow and read millions of digitised books online. The Open Library offers free digital lending of classic and contemporary works. Free Access Visit External WHO Publications — Health Resources Official World Health Organisation publications, guidelines, and health research. Essential for health students in Zanzibar. Free Access Visit Partner American Corner Digital Resources English language learning tools, EducationUSA resources, US cultural content, and digital databases through our American Corner partnership. Partner Access Visit Our Online Catalogue (OPAC) ZLSB's Online Public Access Catalogue gives you real-time access to our full collection — search, filter, check availability, and reserve books from anywhere. Sort by newest, title, author, or rating. Live Availability See exactly how many copies are available at each branch before you make a trip. Online Reservation Reserve a book online and collect it from your preferred ZLSB branch at your convenience.
